_instructions.providers: List of image providers in fallback order. First one is used by default.
_instructions.active_provider: Set to the provider you want to use.
_instructions.openai_image_note: openai_image = gpt-image-2.5-sunburst (OpenAI's current best-quality API image model — draws the full poster, headline/CTA/icons included, directly). openai_image_fallback = gpt-image-1 (still strong, still draws text directly). openai_dalle3 = the older DALL-E 3 model, last-resort only — it predates native text rendering and reliably garbles poster text/logos. All three read OPENAI_API_KEY from .env - the api_key field below is only used as an override.
_instructions.prompt_prefix: Text prepended to every generated prompt.
_instructions.prompt_suffix: Text appended to every generated prompt.
_instructions.override_prompt: If not blank this EXACT text is used as the full prompt. Leave blank for normal operation.
